headline: Virtual instruction day plans, a Taekwondo agreement, and a Tolman Mass Insight contract for approval.
summary: The agenda covers virtual instruction day plans, a Taekwondo MOA, and a Tolman Mass Insight contract. It also includes school presentations and updates, and a possible closed session on an employee's job performance and a Local 930 collective bargaining agreement.
items: Special reports from student representatives at Charles E. Shea High School, William E. Tolman High School, and Jacqueline M. Walsh School for Performing and Visual Arts
PSD RICAS assessment and accountability scores
Tone policing of School Committee members
Possible executive session on an employee's job performance and the Local 930 collective bargaining agreement
Approving to seal executive session minutes, if a closed meeting is held
location: Joseph Jenks Junior High School, 350 Division Street, Pawtucket, RI 02860
